glosses: in kompakter Form von Schnee, Eis oder Eisregen gekennzeichnet

examples.text: „Spätwintermaxima nehmen eine Zwischenstellung zwischen den rein pluvialen Wintermaxima und den stärker nival bestimmten Frühjahrsmaxima ein.“
„Insbesondere das Ansteigen der Schneefallgrenze und die damit einhergehende Tendenz von nival zu pluvial dominierten Ganglinien verdient hier sorgfältige Analyse.“
„Die saisonale Variation im Abfluss ist demnach je nach Lage, Höhenerstreckung und Grad der Vergletscherung des Einzugsgebietes pluvial, nival oder glazial gesteuert.“
„Als nival gilt eine Region, wenn Niederschläge vorwiegend als Schnee niedergehen.“

translations.source_sense_description: Meteorologie; von Niederschlägen: in kompakter Form von Schnee, Eis oder Eisregen gekennzeichnet

glosses: Abounding with snow; snowy; snow-covered (now especially in reference to plant habitats).

examples.text: The observed climate warming during the twentieth century has affected alpine vegetation by increasing vascular plant species richness on nival mountain tops […]

It includes the nival mountain top, the moorlands above the timberline, a belt of tropical rainforest, the semihumid footzone of the tertiary volcano, the semiarid high Laikipia Plateau, the escarpment, and the semiarid to arid Samburu Plains.

In this way, the subnival mountain range on the southern facet with its strong solifluction influence (level slope formation) approaches in height the nival mountain range on the northern facet, which is distinguished by its well developed glacial forms.

glosses: Found or thriving in snowy conditions.

examples.text: In 1884 O. Heer published a comprehensive account of the nival flora of Switzerland, in which he listed 338 species of flowering plants found above 2600 m.; of these, 6 were found above 3900 m.

As can be seen from the present chapter, main problems of adaptation, ecophysiology, ecology and evolutionary biology of the nival fauna were hardly investigated at all.” The early history of explorations of the nival zone in the Alps has been summarized[…]
